resources.string: Nothing seeded. Every arm looks the same on a fully fogged map, so seed a walk before comparing.

The local walk is a fixed synthetic route — a curved corridor, a loop that crosses itself and a detached island — around your current location, or around a public park in Taipei if the device will not give one. Compare arms on that one. The regional fixture writes about 205,000 points scattered across the Taiwan bounding box to load the database — many of them at sea, which loads it just as well; its anchors are almost certainly not where you are, so it leaves your own screen fogged. Both replace whatever was seeded before, are marked as mock, and are removed by Clear.
